newsitem.title: UK: EasyNet says in co-op talks with UK Online.
newsitem.headline: EasyNet says in co-op talks with UK Online.

text.p: EasyNet Group Plc said on Thursday it was in talks with Internet service company UK Online over possible co-operation or for a merger or acquisition.
The Internet access provider, which is quoted on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM), said the talks came in the light of "current consolidation in the Internet industry."
The company said further announcements would be made when talks were concluded.
EasyNet was floated in March and said in September it had a subscriber base of 7,500, up 150 percent since January.
There are about 160 service providers in Britain fighting for revenue in a market that some industry experts say will be worth almost one billion stg by the year 2000.
EasyNet saw pretax losses more than double to 244,133 stg from 100,730 stg in the first half of the year.
